Game Overview

In Fruit Hunter, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the vibrant chaos of Fruit Hunter, where you compete to gather falling fruits while deftly dodging dangerous boxes. Engage in intense 2-player battles, testing your reflexes in a colorful arcade frenzy. Can you outscore your opponent and seize fruity victory?
